retrieval.rag_summary:
Paroc InsulRock
Party Wall Batt represents high-density, non-combustible stone wool (rockwool)
insulation batts engineered for fire and acoustic separation in inter-tenancy
party walls. InsulRock (manufactured using Paroc volcanic rockwool technology
and distributed in Australasia by Fletcher Insulation and regional partners)
provides extreme resistance to shrinkage at temperatures over 1000°C. Meeting
AS 1530.1 non-combustibility and tested for multi-residential FRL compliance, it
controls airborne sound transmission and stops fire spread between adjoining
dwellings.
